text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Gwaaaaah!! I only made the board and 
nothing mooooore!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, no! Something like this makes 
no sense, desu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's strongest has to win! I can't 
accept a result like this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Tell me straight! How was El's 
running just now!?
choice_data_list: That was quite the run, I tell you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Tell me straight! How was El's 
running just now!?
choice_data_list: That was quite the run, I tell you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Please give it to me straight! Keeping 
things vague is no good, yes!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"It can't just be ‘pretty good’—it has to 
be a ‘flawless 100-point’ run, YEEES!!"
choice_data_list:
Let's train aiming for a perfect score of 
100!

Let's train aiming for a perfect score of 
100!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Claro! World's greatest, full-throttle 
sprint! I'd like training like that, 
pleeease!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El would even go climb the cliffs of 
Mexicooo!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ggggrrr! That's so low!! And utterly 
underwhelming, yes it is-!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's so embarrassing... It's even more 
embarrassing than getting a bright red 
failing score on a test, deeeesu!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Howeeeever! The higher the wall of trials, 
the greater the joy when you conquer it!
choice_data_list: Let's climb all the way up the wall!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sì! Next time, I'll be smiling from atop 
that high wall!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa, standing atop the world!! 
Gracefully swooping down, deeeess!!
